example:neutral.writingNotes: Concrete, restrained language about fleets, resources, relationships, and political authority. These notes guide authors; they do not generate text.

messages.campaign.started: {operationCommander.formalName} is assembling a joint fleet at {market.name}.
messages.gathering.invitation: {host.formalName} invites you to a gathering at {market.name}.
messages.competition.invitation: A piloting competition will be held at {market.name}.

recruitment.accept.default: We have an agreement. My fleet will join your faction.

personalities.Upstanding: Your people seem worth standing beside. You can count on my fleet.
personalities.Martial: Your fleet can hold its own. Let's see what we can accomplish together.
personalities.Calculating: The terms are acceptable. I'll arrange the transfer.
personalities.Quarrelsome: I've had enough of them. You'll have my ships. Give us something worth fighting for.

messages.holding.assigned: {recipient.formalName} has assumed command of the {market.name} district.
messages.campaign.started: Task force mobilization is underway at {market.name}, under {operationCommander.formalName}.
messages.gathering.invitation: {host.formalName} invites you to join the officers gathering at {market.name} during shore leave.
messages.competition.invitation: The fleet championship at {market.name} is accepting pilots.

messages.campaign.started: {operationCommander.formalName} is coordinating a joint security operation. Participating fleets will assemble at {market.name}.
messages.gathering.invitation: {host.formalName} invites you to the corporate retreat at {market.name}.
messages.competition.invitation: A sponsored piloting competition at {market.name} is accepting entrants.

personalities.Upstanding: As long as my crews are looked after, we have a deal. I'll arrange the transfer.
personalities.Calculating: A better allocation, a viable operation, and room to advance. We have an agreement.

messages.campaign.started: {operationCommander.fullName} is bringing the crews together at {market.name} for a joint operation.
messages.gathering.invitation: {host.fullName} is hosting a celebration at {market.name}. Your crews are invited.
messages.competition.invitation: Pilots are gathering at {market.name} to compete for the prize.
